name: mylab
description: MyLab — local desktop blood test diagnostics portal

scripts.api:dev: cd express-api && cross-env DESKTOP=1 DB_DIALECT=sqlite SQLITE_PATH=../data/mylab.sqlite npm run dev
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run api:dev" "cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000 npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:4000/health http://localhost:3000 && cross-env MYLAB_DEV_API_PORT=4000 MYLAB_DEV_APP_PORT=3000 electron ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run api:build && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47821 npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run api:build && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47821 npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run api:build && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47821 npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.desktop:publish:mac: npm run api:build && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47821 npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.desktop:publish:win: npm run api:build && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47821 npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win --publish always
